name: OPA350 / OPA2350 / OPA4350
tagline: Burr-Brown 38 MHz rail-to-rail CMOS amp for 5 V rails; Japanese CMoy builders call it thick and 'BB-like'.

lineage.note: Single-supply CMOS design; Burr-Brown datasheet PDS-1470B carries © 1998, printed March 1999.
Acquired Burr-Brown in 2000. SBOS099 dated September 2000, latest rev D December 2015.

part_numbers.note: Single; TI product page live, lifecycle unconfirmed.
DIP-8 / SO-8 / MSOP-8. PA and EA names inferred from suffix convention.
Dual; TI product page shows ACTIVE.
DIP-8 (socketed CMoy builds) / SO-8 / MSOP-8 (VSSOP); reel part OPA2350EA/250.
Quad; TI product page live, lifecycle unconfirmed.

key_specs.value: 5 nV/√Hz HF spot (reportedly 100 kHz); 1 kHz likely higher
CMOS, rail-to-rail in; output within 10 mV of rails

reputation.summary: Praise comes mainly from Japanese hobbyists. nabe's blog calls the OPA2350 thick (音に厚み), with solid bass and a 'BB-like' character, fuller than the AD822, and a recommended DIP pick for 5 V CMoy builds, even without an output buffer. It also appears in a kakaku.com thread on 3 V headphone amps. Western audiophile coverage is thin.
typical_uses: 5 V and battery CMoy-style headphone amplifiers
Low-voltage portable headphone amps, even without output buffer
Single-supply audio processing and ADC driving (TI)
caveats: Absolute maximum supply is about 5.5 V: a ±12 V or ±15 V socket will destroy it.
Praise is subjective and comes from a few Japanese hobbyist sources.
The 5 nV/√Hz headline is a high-frequency figure; CMOS audio-band noise is likely higher.
Rail-to-rail input uses complementary pairs; behaviour can shift in the input crossover region.
Fairly high quiescent current for battery use (about 5 mA per amplifier, unconfirmed).

counterfeit_notes: No family-specific counterfeit reports. Take usual care with DIP-8 OPA2350PA from marketplace sellers: a remarked non-rail-to-rail part shows poor output swing near the rails at 5 V.
alternatives: OPA2353 (lower-power sibling, praised in CMoy builds)

First SBOS099 release at the Burr-Brown/TI transition; replaced Burr-Brown PDS-1470.
Changes unknown; no mirror holding this revision identified.
Revised February 2004; changes unknown. Copy held at Aalborg University.
Changes unknown. Preserved in a Mouser copy (sbos099c).
Current revision, published 21 December 2015; history lists changes from rev C. Probably TI modern format; no die change indicated.

open_questions: Do Burr-Brown PDS-1470 / PDS-1470A editions survive, and when was the OPA350 introduced?
Does SBOS099A (reported July 2001) exist, and what changed in revs A–D?
No PCN naming OPA350/OPA2350/OPA4350 found; does any TI fab-transfer PCN cover them?
Lifecycle status of OPA350, OPA4350 and DIP OPA2350PA; only the OPA2350 base part is confirmed ACTIVE.
Confirm the 5 nV/√Hz frequency (believed 100 kHz), 1 kHz noise and quiescent current against SBOS099D.

claims_confirmed: SBOS099D, dated September 2000 and revised December 2015, covers all three parts: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/opa2350.pdf and https://datasheets.b-cdn.net/files/250-Texas-Instruments-datasheet-10254417.pdf
SBOS099C dated September 2000, revised January 2005: https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/405/sbos099c-92750.pdf and https://www.radiolocman.com/datasheet/data.html?di=279149&%2FOPA350=
SBOS099A reportedly dated July 2001; no mirror holding it identified.
38 MHz GBW, 22 V/µs, 5 nV/√Hz, 0.0006% THD+N, 2.7–5.5 V, output within 10 mV of rails: https://www.ti.com/product/OPA2350
Single and dual in MSOP-8/SO-8/DIP-8; quad in SSOP-16/SO-14: https://users.ece.utexas.edu/~valvano/Datasheets/OPA4350.pdf
Orderable pages for OPA2350EA/250 and OPA4350EA/2K5: https://www.ti.com/product/OPA2350/part-details/OPA2350EA/250 and https://www.ti.com/product/OPA4350/part-details/OPA4350EA/2K5
Burr-Brown mirrors exist for OPA2350, OPA2350UA and OPA2350PA: https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/229267/BURR-BROWN/OPA2350.html
SBOS099D published 21 December 2015; history lists changes from rev C (January 2005) (https://www.ti.com/document-viewer/OPA350/datasheet, https://www.ti.com/product/OPA4350).
Burr-Brown predecessor datasheet footer: © 1998, PDS-1470B, printed March 1999; 38 MHz, 22 V/µs, 5 nV/√Hz (https://manualmachine.com/burrbrown/opa350ua/4144788-datasheet).
Chinese TI datasheet ZHCSHC9D, September 2000 – revised December 2015 (https://www.ti.com.cn/cn/lit/gpn/OPA2350).
No TI PCN naming OPA350, OPA2350 or OPA4350 found among recent TI RFAB/FFAB fab-transfer notices.
